title: Step 5A Preview: Mathematical Evaluator Pilots (v1.0.0)
subject: Mathematics, Science, Accounting & Economics
description: Preview-only validation fixture exercising all five discriminated math-evaluator modes across 15 slides and 18 independent activities.

slides.title: 1. Primary Equivalent & Reduced Fractions
slides.narration: Simplify 6/8 to its lowest reduced fraction.

interactive.title: Simplify 6/8 to Lowest Terms
interactive.instructions: Enter 6/8 as a reduced fraction in lowest terms.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Reduce fraction six eighths to lowest terms
interactive.fallbackText: Divide numerator and denominator by their highest common factor 2: 6/8 = 3/4.
interactive.successExplanation: 3 and 4 share no common factor greater than 1, so 3/4 is in lowest terms.

slides.title: 2. Exact Decimal Rounding (Half-Up Carry-Over)
slides.narration: Round 9.995 to exactly two decimal places using standard half-up rounding.

interactive.title: Round 9.995 to 2 Decimal Places
interactive.instructions: Enter 9.995 rounded to exactly 2 decimal places (half-up). Keep trailing zeros.
interactive.fallbackText: The third decimal digit is 5, so 9.995 rounds up with carry-over to 10.00.
interactive.successExplanation: Exact BigInt decimal arithmetic avoids binary float drift: 9.995 -> 10.00.

slides.title: 3. Expansion & Factorisation (Multi-Activity Slide)
slides.narration: Practise expanding brackets and factorising a difference of two squares in two independent activities on the same slide.

interactive.title: Expand and Simplify 2(x + 3)
interactive.instructions: Multiply out the bracket to obtain an expanded polynomial.

misconceptionChecks.feedback: Remember to multiply BOTH terms inside the bracket by 2 (2 × 3 = 6).

interactive.title: Factorise x² − 9
interactive.instructions: Write x² − 9 in fully factorised form.

slides.title: 4. Collecting Like Terms
slides.narration: Combine like terms in a two-variable linear expression.

interactive.title: Collect Like Terms: 3x + 2y − x + 5y
interactive.instructions: Simplify 3x + 2y − x + 5y by collecting all like terms.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Collect like terms in 3x plus 2y minus x plus 5y

slides.title: 5. Rational Expression with Excluded Value
slides.narration: Simplify a rational algebraic expression while preserving the excluded value from the original denominator.

interactive.title: Simplify (x² − 9) / (x − 3) and State Domain Restriction
interactive.instructions: Enter the simplified expression and state the excluded value of x from the original denominator.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Simplify x squared minus 9 over x minus 3 with domain restriction
interactive.fallbackText: (x² − 9)/(x − 3) = x + 3, with x ≠ 3 because the original denominator vanishes at x = 3.
interactive.successExplanation: Cancelling (x − 3) removes the factor algebraically, but x ≠ 3 remains excluded from the original domain.

slides.title: 6. Linear Equation Solution
slides.narration: Solve a linear equation in one unknown.

interactive.title: Solve 3x − 7 = 11
interactive.instructions: Enter the exact value of x.
interactive.fallbackText: Add 7 to get 3x = 18, then divide by 3 to get x = 6.

slides.title: 7. Quadratic Equation — Complete Solution Set
slides.narration: Find all real roots of a quadratic equation. Submitting only one root is detected as incomplete.

interactive.title: Solve x² − 5x + 6 = 0
interactive.instructions: Enter ALL real roots separated by a comma (e.g. 2, 3).
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Find all roots of x squared minus 5x plus 6 equals 0
interactive.fallbackText: (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, so the complete solution set is {2, 3}.
interactive.successExplanation: Both x = 2 and x = 3 satisfy the quadratic.

slides.title: 8. Radical Equation & Extraneous-Root Rejection
slides.narration: Solve a radical equation and reject any extraneous root introduced by squaring both sides.

visual.caption: Checking roots in the original equation.

interactive.title: Solve √(x + 2) = x
interactive.instructions: Solve √(x + 2) = x and enter ONLY valid real roots that satisfy the original equation.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Solve square root of x plus 2 equals x
interactive.fallbackText: Squaring gives x² − x − 2 = 0 -> x = 2 or x = −1. Checking in the original equation: √(2+2)=2 (valid), √(−1+2)=1 ≠ −1 (extraneous). Only x = 2 is valid.
interactive.successExplanation: x = −1 is extraneous because the principal square root is non-negative.

slides.title: 9. Inequalities & Interval Notation
slides.narration: Express the solution set of a compound inequality as a disjoint union of intervals.

interactive.title: Express x < −2 or x ≥ 5
interactive.instructions: Enter the solution set using interval notation (e.g. (-inf, -2) U [5, inf)) or inequality notation.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Enter interval union for x less than minus 2 or x greater than or equal to 5

slides.title: 10. Surds & Indices Simplification
slides.narration: Extract perfect square factors and combine like surds.

interactive.title: Simplify √12 + √27
interactive.instructions: Write √12 + √27 as a single simplified surd (e.g. 5sqrt(3)).
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Simplify square root of 12 plus square root of 27

slides.title: 11. Logarithmic Identity & Domain Restriction
slides.narration: Combine two natural logarithms while preserving the stricter original domain x > 2.

interactive.title: Combine ln(x) + ln(x − 2) and State Domain
interactive.instructions: Write ln(x) + ln(x − 2) as a single logarithm and state the valid domain for x.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Combine natural log of x plus natural log of x minus 2 with domain
interactive.fallbackText: ln(x) + ln(x − 2) = ln(x(x − 2)) for x > 2 (both x > 0 and x − 2 > 0 must hold).
interactive.successExplanation: Although x(x − 2) > 0 also holds for x < 0, the original expression requires both x > 0 and x > 2, so x > 2.

slides.title: 12. Physics Quantities, Equivalent Units & Sig Figs (Multi-Activity Slide)
slides.narration: Practise equivalent SI unit conversion and scientific notation with exact significant figures.

interactive.title: Average Speed (Equivalent Units Accepted)
interactive.instructions: A vehicle travels 150 m in 12 s. Enter its speed and unit (both m/s and equivalent km/h are accepted).

interactive.title: Speed of Light to 3 Significant Figures
interactive.instructions: Enter 299792458 m/s rounded to 3 significant figures in scientific notation (e.g. 3.00e8 or 3.00 * 10^8).
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Enter speed of light to 3 significant figures in scientific notation

slides.title: 13. Chemistry Concentration & Accounting Margin (Multi-Activity Slide)
slides.narration: Apply exact numerical and unit evaluation across Chemistry and Accounting.

interactive.title: Molar Concentration of NaCl Solution
interactive.instructions: 0.125 mol of NaCl is dissolved in 0.50 dm³ of water. Enter the concentration with unit (mol/dm^3 or mol/m^3).

interactive.title: Gross Profit Margin (%)
interactive.instructions: Revenue is GHS 800 and Cost of Sales is GHS 500. Enter the Gross Profit Margin percentage (with unit %).
interactive.successExplanation: Gross Profit Margin is 37.5% (distinct from mark-up, which is 300/500 = 60%).

slides.title: 14. Supported Symbolic Differentiation
slides.narration: Differentiate a combined polynomial and trigonometric function (with angles in radians).

interactive.title: Find d/dx (3x² + sin(x))
interactive.instructions: Enter the derivative of 3x² + sin(x) with respect to x (radians).
interactive.successExplanation: Power rule gives 6x and d/dx(sin x) = cos x in radians.

slides.title: 15. Supported Antiderivative Verification
slides.narration: Find the general indefinite integral and include the constant of integration + C.

visual.caption: Indefinite integration verified by exact differentiation.

interactive.title: Find ∫ (4x³ − 2x) dx
interactive.instructions: Enter the general indefinite integral of 4x³ − 2x (remember + C).
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Find general indefinite integral of 4x cubed minus 2x
interactive.successExplanation: Differentiating x⁴ − x² + C recovers 4x³ − 2x exactly.
